question: Which of these foods contains vitamin A?
feedback: Great job! Carrots contain beta-carotene, which your body can turn into vitamin A.

question: Which of these is a vegetable?
feedback: Yes! Broccoli is a vegetable. Vegetables give your body vitamins and fiber.

question: Why is it helpful to eat fruits and vegetables of many colors?
options: Different colors can bring different nutrients
Color means the food is candy
feedback: Nice thinking! Orange, green, red, and yellow plants can give your body different helpers called nutrients.

question: Which food is a protein food?
feedback: Eggs are a protein food. Protein helps your body build and repair itself.

question: What does protein help your body do?
feedback: Correct! Protein helps muscles grow and helps your body repair itself after play.

question: Which snack gives you protein?
feedback: Yogurt gives you protein. Drinks and candy that are mostly sugar do not.

question: Carbohydrates mainly give your body what?
feedback: Yes! Carbohydrates are like fuel. Foods such as rice, bread, and fruit give you energy.

question: Which food is a carbohydrate?
feedback: Rice is a carbohydrate. It can give you energy for school and play.

question: Which is a more filling carbohydrate choice for a meal?
feedback: Oatmeal gives longer-lasting energy than candy. Candy can taste fun, and meals still need foods that fill you up.

question: Which food is famous for vitamin C?
feedback: Oranges contain vitamin C. Vitamin C helps your body stay well and heal small scrapes.

question: Calcium in milk helps which body part?
feedback: Great! Calcium is a mineral that helps bones and teeth grow strong.

question: What is a vitamin?
options: A nutrient your body needs in small amounts
feedback: A vitamin is a nutrient. Your body uses vitamins from food for jobs like seeing, healing, and growing.

question: Which drink is the best everyday choice when you are thirsty?
feedback: Water is the best everyday drink. Your body needs water to play, think, and stay comfortable.

question: Why does your body need water?
options: To help it work and cool down
feedback: Your body uses water all day. Drinking water helps you feel ready to learn and play.

question: When is a sweet drink a sometimes drink?
options: When it is full of sugar and not your main drink
Never, because water is not allowed
feedback: Sweet drinks can be a sometimes treat. Water is still the drink your body wants most of the time.

question: A balanced meal has foods from more than one what?
feedback: A balanced meal mixes food groups, such as grains, protein, and fruits or vegetables.

question: Which plate looks balanced?
feedback: That plate has grains, protein, vegetables, and water. Your body gets more helpers from a mix.

question: What can happen if you eat only one kind of food?
options: You may miss nutrients from other foods
feedback: Different foods do different jobs. Eating a mix helps your body get more of what it needs.

question: How can breakfast help you?
options: It gives you energy to start the day
It means you cannot drink water
feedback: Breakfast can give you energy for school and play. It is a helpful way to start the day.

question: What is a kind way to listen to your body at meals?
options: Eat when you are hungry and pause when you feel full
feedback: Your body can tell you when it wants food and when it has had enough. That is a healthy habit.

question: What is true about trying a new vegetable?
options: It can take many tries, and that is okay
You must love it the first time
Children should never try new foods
New foods are a test you can fail
feedback: Tasting something new can take practice. Being curious is enough. You do not have to like every food right away.
